solves.reasoning: have ___ their concerns→expressed, would ___ outsiders from watching→prevent, kindly ___ suggestions→consider ⇒ expressed—prevent—consider
measures to ___ privacy and safety→increase, helps ___ privacy→protect, to ___ unauthorized access→detect ⇒ increase—protect—detect
a few ___ to increase→measures, ___ their exposure to risks→reduces, ___ quickly to incidents→respond ⇒ measures—reduces—respond
③reveal students' privacy는 보호 문맥과 반대 → 원문 protect. 나머지 expressed/prevent/consider는 적절
④respond slowly는 안전강화 목적과 반대 → 원문 quickly. recent/increase/added는 적절
②limit students' privacy and safety는 건의 목적과 반대 → 원문 increase. propose/protect/added는 적절
propose a few ___ to increase safety → measures(대책). problems/holidays/subjects 부적절
prevent ___ from watching students → outsiders(외부인). teachers/flowers/lessons 부적절
added near the ___ to detect unauthorized access → entrances(출입구). libraries/gardens/classrooms 부적절
propose(제안하다)의 동의어 → suggest. refuse/forget/cancel 부적절
incidents(사건)의 동의어 → events. rewards/holidays/benefits 부적절
Additionally(게다가)의 동의어 → In addition. However/Finally/For example 부적절
increase(늘리다)의 반의어 → reduce. expand는 동의 함정, collect/deliver 의미축 다름
prevent(막다)의 반의어 → allow. block은 동의 함정, avoid/observe 의미축 다름
(A) guards watch entrances=감시하다, (B) watch on wrist=손목시계 ⇒ 감시하다—손목시계
'event...unusual/unpleasant/causes a problem' 정의 → incident. schedule/audience/distance 부적절
prevent A from -ing 구문, 전치사 from 뒤 동명사 → watch를 watching으로
소유격 their 뒤 명사 자리 → 동사 expose를 명사 exposure로
detect ___ and respond to incidents → unauthorized access(무단 출입). 나머지는 탐지 대상 부적절
reduces their exposure to ___ → external risks(외부 위험). future benefits/daily routines/school festivals 부적절
